Definition: Shaaph, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Shaaph = "division"; 1) son of Jahdai of the family of Caleb, the brother of Jerahmeel; 2) son of Caleb, the brother of Jerahmeel, by his concubine Maachah and father of Madmannah
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
